# A select whose choice renders afresh the page it is on, on every target.
#
# Choosing a kind changes the panel's rows, and the rows are a table's
# prop, so the slot holding the whole panel -- the select with it -- renders
# again from the select's own handler. On gtk4 that ran inside
# gtk_drop_down_set_selected, which the test's invoker calls, and the
# render's removal let go of the drop-down's last reference while GTK was
# still setting it: a segfault in sngl_drop_down_select, most runs.
# `G_DEBUG=gc-friendly` makes GLib clear what it frees, so a read of the
# freed drop-down fails every run. The invoker now holds the drop-down until
# the selection is done.
#
# It needs the page's weight to show: a picture, a request's answer, a
# context, forty rows; a select alone in a slot survived.

env G_DEBUG=gc-friendly
sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import seq "sngl:seq"
import http "sngl:http"
import i18n "sngl:i18n"
import json "sngl:json"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

const server = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

struct Book {
    title string
}

func fetchBook(title string) async.Result[Book] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/books/{http.pathEscape(title)}") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok {
            match var checked = r.checked() {
                failed { return {failed=checked} }
                ok { return json.decode[Book](checked.body) }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Kind {
    label string
    name  string
}

func kinds() list[Kind] {
    return [Kind{label=$"Red", name="red"}, Kind{label=$"Green", name="green"}, Kind{label=$"Yellow", name="yellow"}, Kind{label=$"Blue", name="blue"}]
}

func named(label string) string {
    for var k = kinds() {
        if k.label == label {
            return k.name
        }
    }
    return "red"
}

component page(name string, form = "", @back(), @open(name string, form string)) ui.node {
    var book option[Book] = null
    var tab = 0
    var kind = $"Red"

    func rows() list[list[string]] {
        var b = book
        var out list[list[string]] = []
        if b != null && named(kind) != "blue" {
            for var i = seq.count(40) {
                out.push(["{b.title} {i}", named(kind)])
            }
        }
        return out
    }

    async.query(on=name, fetch=fetchBook, :value=book)

    ui.vbox(style={gap=8px, padding=8px}) {
        if book != null {
            ui.hbox(style={gap=16px, alignItems=center}) {
                ui.image(alt=book.title, style={width=192px, height=192px}) {
                    ui.remote(url="{server}/dot.png")
                }
            }
            ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
                ui.tab(label="One") {
                    ui.text(value="one")
                }
                ui.tab(label="Kinds") {
                    ui.vbox(style={gap=8px, padding=8px}) {
                        ui.select #pick(:value=kind) {
                            for var k = kinds() {
                                ui.choice(label=k.label)
                            }
                        }
                        ui.table #grid(columns=[$"Title", $"Kind"]) {
                            for var r = rows() {
                                ui.tableRow(cells=r)
                            }
                        }
                        if book != null && rows().length() == 0 {
                            ui.text #none(value=$"None")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

context #shelf("none")

component main ui.node {
    shelf("local") {
        page #p(name="dune", @back {})
    }
}

func testChoosingRebuildsThePanel(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.p.book != null, 5000)
    if c.p.tabs != null {
        c.p.tabs.change(1)
    }
    for var k = ["Blue", "Red", "Yellow", "Blue", "Green", "Blue"] {
        if c.p.pick != null {
            c.p.pick.change(k)
        }
    }
    t.assert(c.p.rows().length() == 0 && c.p.none != null)
}
